candidate_dispositions.reason: Research/source/provenance/Frontier custody is repeatedly distinguished from Tests projection, execution, presentation and validation. A narrow custody edge is necessary to represent that existing authority without treating storage or navigation as ownership.
Tests explicitly projects authority-backed Research objects into METHODS/MODELS/EXPERIMENTS/EVIDENCE contexts by reference, without transferring custody or creating ontology.
Current Test authority defines an ordered four-stage procedural lifecycle. Participation must be run- and phase-scoped and must not be conflated with success or standing.

Evidence relevance and evidentiary standing are distinct in current authority. This normalized edge carries relevance only; positive, adverse, mixed, unresolved or other scientific standing remains a separate field.

Current Research explicitly distinguishes direct from derived evidence and current Test records contain source-bound derivative records. The edge asserts transformation lineage only and never inherits scientific standing.
A current Tests projection registry already contains an authority-backed ROUTE_OPERATOR_PLATFORM -> PROSPECTIVE_FINAL_REPORT_PORTFOLIO EXECUTES instance.
A current Tests projection registry already contains an authority-backed METHODS -> PROSPECTIVE_FINAL_REPORT_PORTFOLIO GOVERNS_PROCEDURE_FOR instance.

The source hierarchy defines INSTRUMENT -> INVARIANT_CANDIDATE with this relation, but that hierarchy is itself marked SUCCESSOR_NORMALIZATION_CANDIDATE. Relation instances may not be manifested without a current authority pointer.
The relation is explicitly typed in the source hierarchy and fits controlled-comparison semantics, but each instance requires current authority.
The source hierarchy declares the bounded model-membership edge. Membership does not itself upgrade standing and each instance requires current authority.

Representation authority may present declared relations without redefining scientific state. Existing source-defined instances support the type, but presentation cannot create scientific relation or standing.

SUPPORTED_WITHIN_BOUNDARY is already a scientific-standing state. Treating SUPPORTS as a generic edge would collapse relation existence into evidentiary strength. Use EVIDENCE_BEARING_ON plus SCIENTIFIC_STANDING=SUPPORTED_WITHIN_BOUNDARY.

Negative, contradicted, mixed and adverse outcomes are standing/disposition states, not one universal relation. Use EVIDENCE_BEARING_ON plus the applicable standing unless a narrower comparator relation is separately authorized.

Current usage spans testing, controlled comparison, calibration and result comparison. A single EVALUATES edge would be semantically underdetermined; use narrower admitted relations or define a future typed comparison contract.
Evidence input is authorized conceptually, but a universal object-level uses-evidence edge needs explicit test/run input binding and evidence authority.
Test returns bounded result records, but current sources do not authorize a universal inverse producer relation for all result types. Do not infer PRODUCED_BY merely from EXECUTES.
